'''Nardek''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] male and a member of the [[Wind Raiders/Legends|Wind Raiders]] tribe on the planet of [[Taloraan/Legends|Taloraan]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].

==Biography==
In [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]], while performing a flight on his [[Fleft-wauf/Legends|fleft-wauf]], another Wind Raider, [[Jeru]], had caught a [[Togruta/Legends|Togruta]] [[Ahsoka Tano/Legends|female]] falling from the sky and intended to take her as a prize. Nardek disputed his claim and [[Bafor]], the tribe's [[Chief/Legends|Chief]], decided that the two would have to fight over the female. The female, who happened to be [[Padawan/Legends|Jedi Padawan]] Ahsoka Tano, refused to be anyone's prize and insisted on joining the combat as well. Physically stronger, Nardek quickly defeated Jeru and was going to take the Togruta for himself. Ahsoka, however, surprised him by demonstrating extreme agility and easily defeated him, using [[The Force/Legends|the Force]].
